scope: Post-hoc structurally specified pooling of exact equal-profile interior integer sources; diagnostic only. Primary fixed-budget results and CI unchanged. No new samples, no oracle rerun, no new confidence claim.
source_class: C={y in Z^n: every |y_j|<=A-2}, A=16n. Full candidate query radius at most1 around receiver within radius1 of source; all queries remain in finite box. Integer translation preserves all four grid counts and original normalization.
formula: N=16Nc; U_C=((sumZ)^2-sumZ^2)/(N(N-1)); full I2 point=(Nc/256)*U_C + (1/256)sum_nonC S1*S2. Nc0 term0. Fixed-class ideal-law unbiasedness and exchangeability variance reduction require separate proof; retrospective choice does not give a new coverage claim.
arithmetic: Fractions of the already saved floating scores, not interval bounds for true proposal or scores; reconstruction checks against primary point estimates only.
stop: One read-only postprocessing of three completed rounds; no class tuning or additional partitions based on outcome.
